selection_record_note: Below groups, reasons and metrics preserve the earlier selection snapshot. All 122 now have implemented V002 rules; former REVIEW_ONLY dispositions are superseded by IMPLEMENTATION_DELIVERY_2026-09-06.md and each policy revision_history.

source.display_index: /api/strategy-universe family mapping using canonical_id and active_arm_ids
source.buy_count: mode=ro indexed aggregation of current definition chain_meme_trader_trades

criteria.zero_trade: known forward_age_seconds >= 36000 and raw BUY count = 0
criteria.low_frequency: known forward_age_seconds >= 36000 and raw BUY count is 1 or 2; BUY count is used because partial SELL legs make total trade-row count ambiguous
criteria.low_cash_loss: cash_usd < 200 and realized_pnl_usd < 0; open positions explicitly distinguish locked cash
criteria.unknown_age_rule: zero-BUY strategies with unknown forward age are not classified as >=10h

interpretation_limits: A candidate can satisfy multiple criteria; counts overlap.
Low cash with open positions is capital lock, not proof that executable total loss exceeds 500 USDC.
Engineering-ineligible rows remain listed but cannot support economic tuning.
Zero BUY supplies no return sample; input/event/state audit precedes any threshold change.
The 32 low-frequency reawakening siblings all bought cohort 10237, so they represent one observed opportunity rather than 32 independent outcomes.
All 122 now have a rule change or explicitly labelled alternative using available inputs; old evidence labels are not reused to claim unavailable events, wallets or decoded flow.
This file is a revision review matrix, not registration or deployment authority.

STRATEGY_083_L0_LOSS_DETERIORATION_V2.reason: Zero-activity exit misses observable multi-frame pool deterioration before writeoff.
STRATEGY_083_L0_LOSS_DETERIORATION_V2.proposed_change: Keep entry and existing exits; after 60s require baseline plus two original-pool frames at least 5s apart with falling price, non-growing liquidity and net recovery below remaining cost, then sell on the next frame.
STRATEGY_083_L0_LOSS_DETERIORATION_V2.pit_boundary: Existing fresh original-pool L0 marks only; no principal-recovered claim and no new RPC.

STRATEGY_126_MAIN_VOLUME_BAND_V2.reason: High transaction count combined with a volume ceiling selects economically tiny bursts.
STRATEGY_126_MAIN_VOLUME_BAND_V2.proposed_change: Keep the ordinary main entry lane, age<120, prior55=0 and at least 50 trades; remove volume<1000 and require volume>=200.
STRATEGY_126_MAIN_VOLUME_BAND_V2.pit_boundary: No isolated observer or two-frame wait because either would shrink the original Broad opportunity coverage.

STRATEGY_127_MATURE_CONFIRMATION_V2.reason: prior55>2 proves weak existence, not mature continuation.
STRATEGY_127_MATURE_CONFIRMATION_V2.proposed_change: Keep age 5-15m and prior55>2 baseline; require two later confirmations each 15-90s apart, active, and holding baseline price/liquidity before next-frame buy.
STRATEGY_127_MATURE_CONFIRMATION_V2.pit_boundary: Choose causal frames from bounded <=80 history; never use dense repeated frames as confirmations.

BROAD_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.reason: Broad immediate entry siblings share the same exhausted-account loss path under fast escape.
BROAD_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.proposed_change: Preserve main full-coverage entry and each exit contract; require current 5-minute activity of at least 3 trades and 200 USDC volume.
BROAD_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.pit_boundary: Current L0 only; no isolated observer, new RPC or backfill.

BROAD_PEAK_GUARD_L0_DECAY_EXIT_V2.reason: Peak-guard arms have low cash and multiple still-open positions; delayed peak logic does not bound pre-peak pool decay.
BROAD_PEAK_GUARD_L0_DECAY_EXIT_V2.proposed_change: Preserve peak guard; add the same 60s baseline plus two-frame loss deterioration exit used by strategy083.
BROAD_PEAK_GUARD_L0_DECAY_EXIT_V2.pit_boundary: Do not infer total PNL while open marks are incomplete; validate only forward.

BROAD_BALANCED_HARVEST_REVIEW_ONLY.reason: Balanced-harvest accounts are low-cash and still open, but current research metrics are engineering-ineligible.
BROAD_BALANCED_HARVEST_REVIEW_ONLY.proposed_change: Preserve the existing harvest contract; do not infer a revision from contaminated or incomplete open-position economics.
BROAD_BALANCED_HARVEST_REVIEW_ONLY.pit_boundary: Old PNL is listed but is not economic evidence; justification comes from the explicit risk contract, not contaminated returns.

BROAD_POSTBUY_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.reason: Post-buy research overlays cannot repair an already-admitted weak broad entry.
BROAD_POSTBUY_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.proposed_change: Keep post-buy overlay, main full-coverage entry and exits; require current 5-minute activity of at least 3 trades and 200 USDC volume.
BROAD_POSTBUY_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.pit_boundary: Research overlay remains non-blocking; no isolated observer or new data source.

SHADOW_L0_LOSS_DETERIORATION_V2.reason: Shadow-entry arms across distinct exits share severe depletion and frequent terminal writeoffs.
SHADOW_L0_LOSS_DETERIORATION_V2.proposed_change: Preserve each distinct exit; add a 60s baseline plus two-frame original-pool loss-deterioration exit.
SHADOW_L0_LOSS_DETERIORATION_V2.pit_boundary: Engineering-ineligible members cannot support economic ranking; they may inherit only the mechanically identical forward safety rule.

DEX_VISIBLE_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.reason: Immediate dex-visible admission creates many identical losing lifecycles across exit siblings.
DEX_VISIBLE_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.proposed_change: Preserve the existing dex-visible main entry and each exit; require current 5-minute activity of at least 3 trades and 200 USDC volume.
DEX_VISIBLE_MAIN_ACTIVITY_FLOOR_V2.pit_boundary: No isolated observer, extra collector/RPC or backfill.

CONDITIONAL_RUNNER_L0_CONFIRMATION_V2.reason: Candidate and control both depleted, so the shared entry is the supported revision target.
CONDITIONAL_RUNNER_L0_CONFIRMATION_V2.proposed_change: Keep their different exits; require the same two independent current L0 continuation frames 15-90 seconds apart before next-frame buy.
CONDITIONAL_RUNNER_L0_CONFIRMATION_V2.pit_boundary: Apply the same entry evidence to both arms to preserve the paired exit comparison.

PRINCIPAL_LOCK_REVIEW_ONLY.reason: Principal-lock account is low-cash with an open remainder and engineering-ineligible history.
PRINCIPAL_LOCK_REVIEW_ONLY.proposed_change: Do not alter principal recovery semantics from contaminated or incomplete economics; retain the existing rule for the next clean period.
PRINCIPAL_LOCK_REVIEW_ONLY.pit_boundary: Never label unrecovered capital as principal_recovered.

LOW_CASH_LOCKED_OPEN_OBSERVATION_ONLY.reason: Cash is below 200 because many positions remain open and executable total PNL is unavailable.
LOW_CASH_LOCKED_OPEN_OBSERVATION_ONLY.proposed_change: Carry the account into the review matrix but do not revise from cash alone; first obtain normal fresh marks/terminal outcomes.
LOW_CASH_LOCKED_OPEN_OBSERVATION_ONLY.pit_boundary: No guessed liquidation value and no forced exit parameter change.

CONTAMINATED_SCALEOUT_REVIEW_ONLY.reason: The account meets loss thresholds but research metrics are engineering-ineligible after prior invalid lifecycle handling.
CONTAMINATED_SCALEOUT_REVIEW_ONLY.proposed_change: Keep listed for completeness; do not tune thresholds from this PNL. Re-enter only through a clean new funding-period contract already fixed at the shared execution layer.
CONTAMINATED_SCALEOUT_REVIEW_ONLY.pit_boundary: Preserve raw history and exclusion flags.

ZERO_EVENT_EVIDENCE_AUDIT.reason: Over 10h with zero BUY; entry requires a rare narrative or authoritative event evidence chain.
ZERO_EVENT_EVIDENCE_AUDIT.proposed_change: Report raw eligible event count, identity match and next-frame handoff separately; no price threshold revision until an event reaches the gate.
ZERO_EVENT_EVIDENCE_AUDIT.pit_boundary: No proxy event, later news or backfill.

ZERO_STATE_OR_RANKER_AUDIT.reason: Over 10h with zero BUY; entry depends on outcome maturity, capital ranking or competing-risk state.
ZERO_STATE_OR_RANKER_AUDIT.proposed_change: Verify state publication age and eligible opportunity count before any rule change; retain finite-capital comparison.
ZERO_STATE_OR_RANKER_AUDIT.pit_boundary: No use of future outcome labels.

ZERO_SURFACE_INPUT_AUDIT.reason: Over 10h with zero BUY; exact venue/lifecycle/amount evidence is the limiting dependency.
ZERO_SURFACE_INPUT_AUDIT.proposed_change: Separate no qualifying surface from missing collector wiring; retain exact identity and amount constraints.
ZERO_SURFACE_INPUT_AUDIT.pit_boundary: No additional high-frequency RPC and no inferred pool identity.

ZERO_ACTUAL_FLOW_INPUT_AUDIT.reason: Over 10h with zero BUY; strategy requires actual observed actor/event flow.
ZERO_ACTUAL_FLOW_INPUT_AUDIT.proposed_change: Verify bounded decoded participation rows and signer semantics; never substitute transaction counts for notional flow.
ZERO_ACTUAL_FLOW_INPUT_AUDIT.pit_boundary: No historical scan or proxy amount.

ZERO_QUIET_REAWAKENING_L0_REVISION_V2.reason: The prior eight-frame 600-second quiet sequence did not fit bounded natural observation coverage.
ZERO_QUIET_REAWAKENING_L0_REVISION_V2.proposed_change: Use three genuine quiet frames spanning at least 120 seconds, then require the existing price, liquidity, activity and mature-pool reawakening evidence.
ZERO_QUIET_REAWAKENING_L0_REVISION_V2.pit_boundary: Existing exact-pool L0 history only; latest frame <=30 seconds and next-frame execution.

ZERO_COMPETING_RISK_L0_REVISION_V2.reason: A model existed but ordinary-loss probability vetoed every mature opportunity; an empty new funding period can also seal an empty model forever.
ZERO_COMPETING_RISK_L0_REVISION_V2.proposed_change: Keep the death-risk veto, replace ordinary-loss veto with a two-frame L0 non-decline confirmation, and seed each new period from clean frozen samples available before activation.
ZERO_COMPETING_RISK_L0_REVISION_V2.pit_boundary: Model cutoff <= activation; current confirmation is strictly post-activation.

ZERO_DURATION_RISK_L0_REVISION_V2.reason: Ordinary-loss incidence vetoed every mature bin; an empty new funding period can also seal an empty duration model forever.
ZERO_DURATION_RISK_L0_REVISION_V2.proposed_change: Keep writeoff plus observation-gap risk veto, replace ordinary-loss veto with a two-frame L0 non-decline confirmation, and seed from clean frozen pre-activation samples.
ZERO_DURATION_RISK_L0_REVISION_V2.pit_boundary: Model cutoff <= activation; current confirmation is strictly post-activation.

LOW_FREQUENCY_REAWAKENING_REVIEW_ONLY.reason: Thirty-two sibling arms share one completed reawakening cohort, so coverage is one opportunity.
LOW_FREQUENCY_REAWAKENING_REVIEW_ONLY.proposed_change: Preserve each hypothesis at its old revision and record the shared opportunity basis in the review only; do not tune from one lifecycle.
LOW_FREQUENCY_REAWAKENING_REVIEW_ONLY.pit_boundary: No threshold relaxation, duplicated sample claim or historical replay.

LOW_FREQUENCY_PARTICIPATION_REVIEW_ONLY.reason: Only one completed participation lifecycle exists after ten hours.
LOW_FREQUENCY_PARTICIPATION_REVIEW_ONLY.proposed_change: Preserve the verified-participation gate and accumulate natural forward evidence.
LOW_FREQUENCY_PARTICIPATION_REVIEW_ONLY.pit_boundary: No signer proxy, historical scan or threshold relaxation.

LOW_FREQUENCY_ACTUAL_FLOW_REVIEW_ONLY.reason: Only one completed capital-velocity lifecycle exists after ten hours.
LOW_FREQUENCY_ACTUAL_FLOW_REVIEW_ONLY.proposed_change: Preserve amountful-flow semantics and accumulate natural forward evidence.

LOW_FREQUENCY_L0_OPPORTUNITY_REVIEW_ONLY.reason: The two L0 hypotheses have only one or two completed lifecycles.
LOW_FREQUENCY_L0_OPPORTUNITY_REVIEW_ONLY.proposed_change: Preserve the distinct prebreakout/liquidity-lead rules and collect more clean opportunities.
LOW_FREQUENCY_L0_OPPORTUNITY_REVIEW_ONLY.pit_boundary: No loosening solely to manufacture trades.

LOW_FREQUENCY_COMMON_FUNDING_REVIEW_ONLY.reason: Only one completed 5U common-funding breadth lifecycle exists.
LOW_FREQUENCY_COMMON_FUNDING_REVIEW_ONLY.proposed_change: Preserve the selective breadth contract and accumulate natural forward evidence.
LOW_FREQUENCY_COMMON_FUNDING_REVIEW_ONLY.pit_boundary: No economic inference from one outcome.
